raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
r _ {c} = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} m c ^ {2}},
$$

(即所谓的经典电子半径，可以通过将电子的质量转化为其存储在电场中的能量，并结合爱因斯坦公式 $E = m c ^ { 2 }$ 得到 ，其角动量为 $( 1 / 2 ) \hbar$ ，那么"赤道"上的一点运动的速度 $\mathrm { ( m / s ) }$ 有多快?这个模型有意义吗? (实际上，实验上已知的电子半径要比$r _ { c }$ 小得多，但这只会使情况变得更糟.)①

#
raw_problem.solution_text:
$$
r _ {c} = \frac {\left(1 . 6 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 9}\right) ^ {2}}{4 \pi (8 . 8 5 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 2}) (9 . 1 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 1}) (3 . 0 \times 1 0 ^ {8}) ^ {2}} = 2. 8 0 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 5} (\mathrm {m}),
$$

$$
L = \frac {1}{2} \hbar = I \omega = \left(\frac {2}{5} m r ^ {2}\right) \left(\frac {v}{r}\right) = \frac {2}{5} m r v,
$$

则

$$
v = \frac {5 \hbar}{4 m r} = \frac {5 \times (1 . 0 5 5 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 4})}{4 \times (9 . 1 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 1}) (2 . 8 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 5})} = 5. 1 5 \times 1 0 ^ {1 0} (\mathrm {m / s}).
$$

这个模型没有实际意义，国为它的速度为光边的 100 多倍.

# 习题 4.29

(a) 验证自旋矩阵(方程 (4.145) (4.147)) 满足方程 (4.134) 的角动量对易关系.  
(b) 证明:泡利自旋矩阵(方程 (4.148)) 满足乘积定则

$$
\sigma_ {j} \sigma_ {k} = \delta_ {j k} + \sum_ {l} \varepsilon_ {j k l} \sigma_ {l},
$$

这里指标代表 $y$ 或 $z , \varepsilon _ { j k l }$ 是莱维一开维塔符号:如果 $j k l = 1 2 3$ , 231 312，为$+ 1$ 如果 $j k l = 1 3 2$ , 213 321，为一1; 其余为零.

解答(a)由

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {x} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {S} _ {y} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {S} _ {z} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right),
$$

可得

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ S _ {x}, S _ {y} ] = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {x} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {y} - \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {y} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {x} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) - \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} \mathrm {i} & 0 \\ 0 & - \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) - \left( \begin{array}{c c} - \mathrm {i} & 0 \\ 0 & \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 2 \mathrm {i} & 0 \\ 0 & - 2 \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar S _ {z}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ S _ {y}, S _ {z} ] = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {y} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {z} - \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {z} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {y} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) - \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) - \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ - \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 2 \mathrm {i} \\ 2 \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar S _ {x}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ S _ {z}, S _ {x} ] = \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {z} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {x} - \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {x} \boldsymbol {\mathcal {S}} _ {z} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) - \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) - \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 2 \\ - 2 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar S _ {y}. \\ \end{array}
$$

这三个式子可以用矢量表示为

$$
\boldsymbol {S} \times \boldsymbol {S} = \mathrm {i} \hbar \boldsymbol {S}.
$$

(b) 由抱利矩阵与自旋矩阵的关系 $\pmb { S } = \frac { \hbar } { 2 } \sigma .$ ，得

$$
\sigma_ {x} \sigma_ {x} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) = 1,
$$

$$
\sigma_ {y} \sigma_ {y} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) = 1,
$$

$$
\sigma_ {z} \sigma_ {z} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) = 1,
$$

$$
\sigma_ {x} \sigma_ {y} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} \mathrm {i} & 0 \\ 0 & - \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \sigma_ {z},
$$

$$
\sigma_ {y} \sigma_ {x} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} - \mathrm {i} & 0 \\ 0 & \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) = - \mathrm {i} \sigma_ {z},
$$

$$
\sigma_ {z} \sigma_ {x} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \sigma_ {y},
$$

$$
\sigma_ {x} \sigma_ {z} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) = - \mathrm {i} \sigma_ {y},
$$

$$
\sigma_ {y} \sigma_ {z} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \mathrm {i} \sigma_ {x},
$$

$$
\sigma_ {z} \sigma_ {y} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ - \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) = - \mathrm {i} \sigma_ {x}
$$

把这些式子合并在一起有

$$
\sigma_ {j} \sigma_ {k} = \delta_ {j k} + \sum_ {l} \varepsilon_ {j k l} \sigma_ {l}.
$$

申习题 4.30 粒子处在自旋态

$$
\chi = A \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ 4 \end{array} \right).
$$

(a) 求归一化常数 $A$   
(b) $S _ { x }$ $S _ { y }$ 和 $S _ { z }$ 的期望值.   
(c) 求出 $\sigma _ { S _ { x } }$ $\sigma _ { S _ { y } }$ 和 $\sigma _ { S _ { z } }$ 的"不确定度'飞注意 这里的 $\sigma$ 是标准方差，不是泡利矩阵!  
(d) 确认所得结果符合所有三个不确定性原理(当然，方程 (4.100) 及其循环置 换仅仅需要将 $S$ 替代 $L$ .

解答 (a) 波函数归一化

$$
\begin{array}{l} \chi^ {\dagger} \chi = | A | ^ {2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ 4 \end{array} \right) = 2 5   | A | ^ {2} = 1 \\ \Rightarrow A = \frac {1}{5}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) 期望值

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {x} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {x} \chi = \frac {1}{2 5} \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ 4 \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{5 0} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 4 \\ 3 \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar}{5 0} (- 1 2 \mathrm {i} + 1 2 \mathrm {i}) = 0, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {y} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {y} \chi = \frac {1}{2 5} \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ 4 \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{5 0} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} - 4 \mathrm {i} \\ - 3 \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar}{5 0} (- 1 2 - 1 2) = - \frac {1 2}{2 5} \hbar , \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {z} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {z} \chi = \frac {1}{2 5} \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ 4 \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{5 0} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ - 4 \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar}{5 0} (9 - 1 6) = - \frac {7}{5 0} \hbar . \\ \end{array}
$$

(c) 期望值

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S_{x}^{2}\rangle = \chi^{\left(\dagger\right)}\boldsymbol{S}_{x}\boldsymbol{S}_{x}\chi = \frac{1}{25}\left(\frac{\hbar}{2}\right)^{2}\left( \begin{array}{cc} - 3\mathrm{i} & 4 \end{array} \right)\left( \begin{array}{cc}0 & 1\\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right)\left( \begin{array}{cc}0 & 1\\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right)\left( \begin{array}{c}3\mathrm{i}\\ 4 \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{1 0 0} \left( \begin{array}{c c} - 3 \mathrm {i} & 4 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} 3 \mathrm {i} \\ 4 \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{1 0 0} (9 + 1 6) = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4}. \\ \end{array}
$$

由于 $S _ { x } ^ { 2 } , S _ { y } ^ { 2 } , S _ { z } ^ { 2 }$ 只有一个本征值I. ..--- 1i2 $\frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 }$ 所以对任何自旋态都有

$$
\langle S _ {x} ^ {2} \rangle = \langle S _ {y} ^ {2} \rangle = \langle S _ {z} ^ {2} \rangle = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4},
$$

因此标准差为

$\forall \sigma _ { S _ { x } } ^ { 2 } = \langle S _ { x } ^ { 2 } \rangle - \langle S _ { x } \rangle ^ { 2 } = \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 } - 0 = \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 } ,$ ，得 S.. $\sigma _ { S _ { x } } = \frac { \hbar } { 2 }$

$\mathrm { \ i } \sigma _ { S _ { y } } ^ { 2 } = \langle S _ { y } ^ { 2 } \rangle - \langle S _ { y } \rangle ^ { 2 } = \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 } - \left( - \frac { 1 2 } { 2 5 } \hbar \right) ^ { 2 } = \frac { 4 9 } { 2 5 0 0 } \hbar ^ { 2 }$ ，得 , . ~ $\sigma _ { S _ { y } } = \frac { 7 } { 5 0 } \hbar$

$\natural \sigma _ { S _ { z } } ^ { 2 } = \langle \hat { s } _ { z } ^ { 2 } \rangle - \langle \hat { s } _ { z } \rangle ^ { 2 } = \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 } - \left( - \frac { 7 } { 5 0 } \hbar \right) ^ { 2 } = \frac { 5 7 6 } { 2 5 0 0 } \hbar ^ { 2 }$ ( 7 _\2-(一 .:"ñ) \ 50'} _'l ， ñ，~， S" = $\sigma _ { S _ { z } } = \frac { 1 2 } { 2 5 } \hbar$

(d) 不确定性关系

$$
\sigma_ {S _ {x}} \sigma_ {S _ {y}} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \cdot \frac {7}{5 0} \hbar \geqslant \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \langle \hat {S} _ {z} \rangle \right| = \frac {\hbar}{2} \cdot \frac {7}{5 0} \hbar ,
$$

$$
\sigma_ {S _ {y}} \sigma_ {S _ {z}} = \frac {7}{5 0} \hbar \cdot \frac {1 2}{2 5} \hbar \geqslant \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \langle \hat {S} _ {x} \rangle \right| = 0,
$$

$$
\sigma_ {S _ {z}} \sigma_ {S _ {x}} = \frac {1 2}{2 5} \hbar \cdot \frac {\hbar}{2} \geqslant \frac {\hbar}{2} \left| \langle \hat {S} _ {y} \rangle \right| = \frac {\hbar}{2} \cdot \frac {1 2}{2 5} \hbar ,
$$

显然满足不确定性原理.

串习题 4.31 对最一般的归一化旋量 $\chi$ (方程 (4.139)) ，计算 $\left. S _ { x } \right. , \left. S _ { y } \right. , \left. S _ { z } \right.$ ,$\left. S _ { x } ^ { 2 } \right. , \left. S _ { y } ^ { 2 } \right.$ 和 $\langle S _ { z } ^ { 2 } \rangle$ ，井验证 $\left. S _ { x } ^ { 2 } \right. + \left. S _ { y } ^ { 2 } \right. + \left. S _ { z } ^ { 2 } \right. = \left. S ^ { 2 } \right.$ •

解答期望值

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {x} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {x} \chi = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} b \\ a \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left(a ^ {*} b + b ^ {*} a\right) = \hbar \mathrm {R e} \left(a ^ {*} b\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {y} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {y} \chi = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} - \mathrm {i} b \\ \mathrm {i} a \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left(- \mathrm {i} a ^ {*} b + \mathrm {i} b ^ {*} a\right) = - \hbar \mathrm {I m} \left(b ^ {*} a\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle S _ {z} \rangle = \chi^ {\dagger} \boldsymbol {S} _ {z} \chi = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} a ^ {*} & b ^ {*} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ - b \end{array} \right) = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left(a ^ {*} a - b ^ {*} b\right) = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left(| a | ^ {2} - | b | ^ {2}\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

对任何 (自旋 $\frac { 1 } { 2 }$ ）自旋态都有

$$
\left\langle S _ {x} ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle S _ {y} ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle S _ {z} ^ {2} \right\rangle = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4},
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle S ^ {2} \right\rangle = \left\langle S _ {x} ^ {2} \right\rangle + \left\langle S _ {y} ^ {2} \right\rangle + \left\langle S _ {z} ^ {2} \right\rangle = \frac {3 \hbar^ {2}}{4} \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {1}{2} + 1\right) \hbar^ {2} = s (s + 1) \hbar^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

即对任何(自 $\frac { 1 } { 2 }$ ~)自旋 $S ^ { 2 }$ 州期望值都是 3h2 ${ \frac { 3 \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 } } , S ^ { 2 }$ ， 只有一个本征 3h² $\frac { 3 \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 4 }$

# 串习题 4.32

(a) 求出 $\mathcal { S } _ { y }$ 的本征值和本征旋量.   
(b) 对处在一般态 $\chi$ 上的粒子(方程 (4.139)) 测量其 $\mathcal { S } _ { y }$ ，可能得到哪些值?每个值的几率是多少?验证几率之和为1.注意 $a$ 和 $b$ 不一定是实数!  
(c) 如果测量 $S _ { y } ^ { 2 }$ 可能得到什么值?它们的几率是多少?

解答 (a)

$$
\boldsymbol {S} _ {y} = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

本征方程为

$$
\frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right) = \lambda \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right).
$$

解久期方程(特征方程)，得

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} - \lambda & - \mathrm {i} \hbar / 2 \\ \mathrm {i} \hbar / 2 & - \lambda \end{array} \right| = 0,
$$

$$
\lambda^ {2} - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} = 0,
$$

$$
\lambda = \pm \frac {\hbar}{2}.
$$

(当然对任一分量本征值都为 $\pm \frac { \hbar } { 2 }$ )

将本征值代回本征方程，得

$$
\frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right) = \pm \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right),
$$

$$
- \mathrm {i} \beta = \pm \alpha ;
$$

$$
\left| \alpha \right| ^ {2} + \left| \beta \right| ^ {2} = 1,
$$

$$
\alpha = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}}.
$$

所以 $\mathcal { S } _ { y }$ 的本征态为

$\chi _ { + } ^ { ( y ) } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( \begin{array} { c } { 1 } \\ { \mathrm { i } } \end{array} \right) , \left( \ast \ast \llangle \ddagger { i } { \mathbb { E } } ^ { \{ i \neq \nmid \nmid } \ast \nmid  \frac { \hbar } { 2 } \right) ; \chi _ { - } ^ { ( y ) } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( \begin{array} { c } { 1 } \\ { - \mathrm { i } } \end{array} \right) , \left( \ast \llangle \ddagger { i } { \mathbb { E } } ^ { \{ i \not { \in \forall } \} } - \frac { \hbar } { 2 } \right) .$

(b) 对一般态把它按 $\boldsymbol { s } _ { y }$ 的本征态展开:

$$
\chi = \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \end{array} \right) = c _ {+} \chi_ {+} ^ {(y)} + c _ {-} \chi_ {-} ^ {(y)},
$$

由本征态的正交归一性，得

$$
c _ {+} = \left(\chi_ {+} ^ {(y)}\right) ^ {\dagger} \chi = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & - \mathrm {i} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} a \\ b \end{array} \right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(a - \mathrm {i} b\right),
$$

求 $\pmb { S } _ { r }$ 的本征值和(归一化的)本征旋量.答案:

注意 你总可以在结果上乘以任意的相位因子一一比如说， $\mathrm { e } ^ { \mathrm { i } \phi }$ 一一所以你的结果与我的结果可能不完全一样

解答 自旋角动量矩阵的分量

$$
\begin{array}{l} \boldsymbol {S} _ {r} = \boldsymbol {S} \cdot \hat {\boldsymbol {r}} = S _ {x} \sin \theta \cos \phi + S _ {y} \sin \theta \sin \phi + S _ {z} \cos \theta \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \sin \theta \cos \phi + \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \\ \mathrm {i} & 0 \end{array} \right) \sin \theta \sin \phi + \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \cos \theta \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left[ \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & \sin \theta \cos \phi \\ \sin \theta \cos \phi & 0 \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & - \mathrm {i} \sin \theta \sin \phi \\ \mathrm {i} \sin \theta \sin \phi & 0 \end{array} \right) \right. \\ \left. + \left( \begin{array}{c c} \cos \theta & 0 \\ 0 & - \cos \theta \end{array} \right) \right] \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} \cos \theta & \sin \theta (\cos \phi - \mathrm {i} \sin \phi) \\ \sin \theta (\cos \phi + \mathrm {i} \sin \phi) & - \cos \theta \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} \cos \theta & \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta \\ \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta & - \cos \theta \end{array} \right). \\ \end{array}
$$

本征方程为

$$
\frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} \cos \theta & \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta \\ \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta & - \cos \theta \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right) = \lambda \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right).
$$

解久期方程，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left| \begin{array}{c c} \frac {\hbar}{2} \cos \theta - \lambda & \frac {\hbar}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta \\ \frac {\hbar}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta & - \frac {\hbar}{2} \cos \theta - \lambda \end{array} \right| = 0 \\ \Rightarrow - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \cos^ {2} \theta + \lambda^ {2} - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{4} \sin^ {2} \theta = 0 \\ \Rightarrow \lambda = \pm \frac {\hbar}{2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

将本征值代回本征方程，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c c} \cos \theta & \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta \\ \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta & - \cos \theta \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right) = \pm \frac {\hbar}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c} \alpha \\ \beta \end{array} \right) \\ \Rightarrow \alpha \cos \theta + \beta \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta = \pm \alpha \\ \Rightarrow \beta = \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \frac {\pm 1 - \cos \theta}{\sin \theta} \alpha . \\ \end{array}
$$

归一化

$$
| \alpha | ^ {2} + | \beta | ^ {2} = 1 \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \alpha = \cos \frac {\theta}{2}, \beta = \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \frac {\theta}{2} \Rightarrow \chi_ {+} ^ {(r)} = \left( \begin{array}{c} \cos \frac {\theta}{2} \\ \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \frac {\theta}{2} \end{array} \right) \\ \alpha = \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \frac {\theta}{2}, \beta = - \cos \frac {\theta}{2} \Rightarrow \chi_ {-} ^ {(r)} = \left( \begin{array}{c} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \frac {\theta}{2} \\ - \cos \frac {\theta}{2} \end{array} \right) \end{array} . \right.
$$
